subject: reasoning
question: SFBV is related to HUYE in a certain way based on a certain relationship between the given letters in the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JQEF is related to QJVU. Which of the given options is CKSW related to following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'SFBV is related to HUYE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eeba248456ecf99451b215cbe5c3fac16888442872366d5108f4b20d5e45619.png] 

For, 'JQEF is related to QJVU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caf809eb8b1119df0c67dc2d5629b0a995cc3effe3593d098bbb3121967f14fa.png] 

Similarly, for '**CKSW**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c63277aa32b4a55b5aa3247a055d17a99afdbfd6676cee1ee1877a612282b966.png] 

So, 'CKSW' will be related to '**XPHD**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
